label: digit 0/1/2 input early in the original phase (strongest for 0)
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase (never at t=0, the delimiter, or the copy phase), almost always when the input is the digit 0, 2 or 1 (0 alone holds ~60% of activation mass, 2 ~23%, 1 ~11%; digit 3 never fires it); small leftover activity on h and z. Rate is highest at positions 1-3 and falls off by position 5-7, and it is mostly a first occurrence of the token (93% of mass). Top activations are a 0 that comes after context tokens such as p/b/s/3 at the start of the sequence (rate by first token goes up about 3x); I could not turn that context dependence into a clean predicate. Precision is low: most early 0/1/2 inputs do not cross the threshold. Seeing 0/1/2 at positions 1-4 covers about 88% of activation mass at F1 around 0.41.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=p (+4.92), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=0 (+4.12), phase=0 & in_tok=0 (+4.12), t=1 & prev_tok=1 (+3.84), orig0=s (+3.80), t=1 & prev_tok=2 (+3.76). Lower it: t=1 & prev_tok=p (-7.65), t=1 & prev_tok=3 (-6.54), t=8 (-5.99), t=7 (-4.53).
